definitions.full: H1468. guz I. [ גּוּז ] verb pass over, away (Arabic pass by, over ; Aramaic גּוּז cross , pass away, fail — Qal Perfect גָּז Psa 90:10 ; Imperfect וַיָּ֫גָז Num 11:31 ; — pass away , of the life of the aged, Psa 90:10 חִישׁ גָּז ; transitive bring over, subject wind, object quails from sea, Num 11:31 (read perhaps Hiph`il וַיָּגֶז compare Kö i. 442 Di).
